note: The rules each prompt version adds after generator.py's SYSTEM (workshop lesson 12.4), read and checked by prompt_rules.py. A version's rules are appended to SYSTEM's own five and numbered on from 6; PROMPT_VERSION, which config.py's prompt_version reads, names the version a revision answers under. v3, the default, adds none, so SYSTEM is served byte for byte. Append-only: a version's rules begin with the rules of the version before it, unchanged, and a new rule is a new version. evals/improve.py writes a version after a person accepts its rule (make improve REVIEWER=), recording who and when; nothing edits one.
